evaluation.cohort: Existing ordinary TRAIN recording panel, previously exposed for development

source.splits: Official platform TRAIN only, one separate model per source; recording-disjoint fit and head selection
source.budgets_are_caps: For small platforms choose fit and holdout recordings using unique frame counts only. Log shortfalls after content exclusion.
source.natural_reference: Known only where resolved via singular language role, class and unique compatible visible annotated instance. Ambiguous and absent inventory remain unknown.
source.synthetic_reference: Explicit geometry-checked left and right pairs from the source inventory, with same-class subject alternatives

proposal.roles: Both roles score every carrier. Subject never uses a shortlist.

optimization.selection: Use only the corresponding source held-out recordings and the fixed criterion in train.py

adoption: Measure paired six-direction Acc@25, Acc@50, mIoU and coverage. Preserve all adverse outcomes. Subject and reference identity support is evaluated on the source holdout with respective label provenance. Warn when a target claim remains unverified.
